message.content: I have annual revenue for FY2018–FY2024. Let me compute the year-over-year growth rates.

# Palantir Technologies — Revenue Growth Trend (FY2018–FY2024)

**Definition used:** Total revenue as reported under US-GAAP tag `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax` (consolidated, no segment dimension), full fiscal years ending December 31. Values are raw USD; growth rates are my calculations from the disclosed figures.

| Fiscal year | Revenue (USD) | YoY growth |
|---|---|---|
| 2018 | 595,409,000 | — |
| 2019 | 742,555,000 | +24.7% |
| 2020 | 1,092,673,000 | +47.2% |
| 2021 | 1,541,889,000 | +41.1% |
| 2022 | 1,905,871,000 | +23.6% |
| 2023 | 2,225,012,000 | +16.7% |
| 2024 | 2,865,507,000 | +28.8% |

**Trend narrative:** Revenue rose every year, roughly 4.8× from 2018 to 2024, but growth was clearly decelerating through 2023 before re-accelerating in 2024. Growth peaked at about 47% in 2020, stayed above 40% in 2021, then slowed sharply to ~24% in 2022 and a trough of ~17% in 2023. FY2024 rebounded to ~29%, the strongest rate since 2021.

**Early-2025 momentum (quarterly, for context):** Q1 2025 revenue was 883,855,000 vs 634,338,000 in Q1 2024 (+39.3%), and Q2 2025 was 1,003,697,000 vs 678,134,000 in Q2 2024 (+48.0%) — indicating the 2024 re-acceleration continued into the first half of 2025. (These are quarterly flows, not annual figures, and are shown only as directional context.)

**Sources (fact IDs, all CIK 1321655):**
- FY2018: id 1587060; FY2019: id 1587061 (10-K filed 2021-02-26, accession 0001193125-21-060650)
- FY2020: id 1587068 (10-K filed 2021-02-26, accession 0001193125-21-060650)
- FY2021: id 1587081 (10-K filed 2022-02-24, accession 0001193125-22-050913)
- FY2022: id 1587094 (10-K filed 2023-02-21, accession 0001321655-23-000011)
- FY2023: id 1587107 (10-K filed 2024-02-20, accession 0001321655-24-000022)
- FY2024: id 1587117 (10-K filed 2025-02-18, accession 0001321655-25-000022)
- Q1 2025: id 1587118; Q1 2024: id 1587109; Q2 2025: id 1587119; Q2 2024: id 1587113

**Limitations:** The database contains no FY2017 revenue, so the FY2018 growth rate cannot be computed. Duplicate comparative disclosures of the same annual figures across later filings were not summed; the latest applicable annual disclosure was used for each year. The bundled annual report snapshot is for FY2024 only, so the FY2025 quarterly figures come from structured 10-Q facts rather than a full-year report.
